manifestHashRecognition.statement: heldout entries contain family metadata, not individual original hashes. freeze hashes pin manifests, not original files. assets[].original.sha256/bytes pin development originals; no restricted/private original hash inventory is supplied. A previously unseen held-out original cannot be recognised from this manifest alone. The case-original rule can only exclude it from development/evaluation records, not identify its hidden family by hash.

manifestLicence.statement: purpose test_only; permission.state unconfirmed is not a reuse/training grant; teacher sees development profiles only; held-out originals remain outside Git for evaluation only.

approvedMappingFlow.statement: Approval updates usp_mapping_recipes and appends usp_mapping_recipe_revisions, an operations receipt and case event. Tabular execute remains TABULAR_REGISTRY_UNQUALIFIED. After approval calls queueApprovedTabular.
queueApprovedTabular reuses/enqueues a streaming-vector job, then enqueues the existing chunk-mapping job. No development family key is used for those job ids.
Writes jobs, job-authority input metadata, usp_streaming_vector_imports, operations and case event; sourceFamilyId is retained-source revision UUID lineage, not developmentFamily.

Approved route learns before mapping; mapper receives approved plan and bypasses teacher. Writes mapped payload, usp_chunk_mapping_slots, import watermark/counts and event. Proposal-only route can traverse memory/student/teacher.

Writes examples.jsonl, profile-links.jsonl, accepted-plans.jsonl, learner artifacts/completed.json and manual-learn operations record. profile-links uses developmentFamily as family and split dev; calibration guard prevents mi-d03 fit.

Memory key is exact layout fingerprint, with officer decision id for idempotency. No family is required. Closed entry/lineage schemas currently have no origin field, so recording origin officer_supplied requires a schema extension outside TB6 ownership.

Online update invokes shared load_examples; split/family are required and checked against development membership; persisted trainingExamples requires family. Cross-fit splits and scores by family. Case originals without family cannot be loaded or persisted.

locations.statement: retain profiles locally and stores originals; does not call a provider.
Ingestion-side routing decision supplies hard-coded public/development policy; this is the seam to derive policy and inject a refusal callback for a case original before any teacher request is built.

Approved plan/cache/layout memory first; otherwise proposeMapping runs local learner before teacher. An ingestion teacher callback may return manualTeacherPlan with a refusal code while keeping local paths available.
remainingTeacher rejects held_out or non-public policy after local memory/student; otherwise dispatches options.teacher or proposeMappingWithTeacher.

Gateway decision: proposeMappingWithTeacher rejects non-public/held_out before mappingTeacherColumnGroups builds payload; runtime resolves gateway separately; callTeacherOnce invokes gateway.propose with current authorization, budget and profile hash.

payload.statement: Sends column-profile version/sourceKind/sampleShortfall; per column: header, sourceField alias, inferredType, optional declaredUnit, valueShapes rates, maskedSamples; plus canonical target vocabulary and optional validation error codes. No raw rows, issuer, filename, absolute counts or source original bytes are sent. Samples may be reduced to zero; wide tables grouped at 250-260.

Sample masking substitutes arbitrary free-text words and digits, detects personal headers, masks contact patterns, but deliberately preserves safe categorical/unit words. Shape rates include null/blank/absent/distinct ratios; sample count can be observed from array length.
Shared minimizer reapplies structured privacy redaction before network payload construction.
Structured strings are redacted by value patterns/personal field keys; header is not a personal key.
Personal keys and numeric/email patterns protected; arbitrary names in prose explicitly require a qualified review route. Unlabelled firm/person text in a header may pass unchanged.

teacherPath.decisionForResume: Refuse provider path for EVERY case_original, before request construction, with one stable ingestion refusal code. Do not change masking in TB6. Header masking only removes email/PAN/long digits; arbitrary firm/person names in headers can leave. Safe categorical cell tokens also intentionally survive sample masking. No actual provider call or payload was sent.
teacherPath.ownershipGap: chunk-mapping-tabular.ts is the ingestion policy seam but is not among owned edit paths. mapping-teacher.ts and mapping-memory.ts are also outside owned paths; lead must explicitly assign the narrow refusal and memory-origin schema seams.

retainProvenanceToday.statement: AnyRetainSourceSchema permits requestKey, expectedWorkspaceRevision, format, optional familyId/expectedSourceRevision, and table selection. Strict table branch has no issuer, origin, licence or containsPersonalData.

sources row keeps id/case/family/revision, filename, profile, MIME, size/hash, object key, status and inspection JSON. inspection contains actor and manualProfile with pin/profile/limitations; it cannot keep unstated retain provenance today. family_id is revision lineage, not a development family.

stopRule.reason: A learning record cannot exist without a development/pool family under the current learner loader and persisted model manifest. Stop after Step 0 as requested; no pin/admission/contract changes.

proof.statement: Approved learning emits family/split links and passes them to stage_a online; omitting them cannot bypass that existing loader.
Direct link[split] and link[family] subscripts require both; missing either raises KeyError before fitting. Fabricating dev/pool family would violate task data rules.
version_manifest directly indexes family in every trainingExamples record; online_update shares load_examples and family-based calibration access.

Keep case originals excluded from development loading, cross-fit, calibration, family scoring and held-out evaluation; do not create a default family or silently tag pool.

Assign the ingestion routing seam in chunk-mapping-tabular.ts so every case original is refused before teacher payload construction; no masking changes in this task.
